Q: Query to select a value of a column of a table identified by a value of another table A:

Suggesting that SELECT sogg_ID FROM tableA where ID_A=targetIdis quite simple (take few row from tableA), we can process each table B,C,D separately an then use UNION ALL.

Access query with parameter

PARAMETERS targetId long;
SELECT 'B' as tbl, ID_B as sogg_ID,Nome_B    as NomeN,Cogn_B as CognN FROM tableB
WHERE ID_B IN(SELECT sogg_ID FROM tableA where ID_A=targetId)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'C' as tbl, ID_C as sogg_ID, Nome_C   as NomeN, Cogn_C as CognN  FROM tableC
WHERE ID_C IN(SELECT sogg_ID FROM tableA where ID_A=targetId)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'D' as tbl, ID_D as sogg_ID, Nome_D as NomeN, Cogn_D as CognN  FROM tableD
WHERE ID_D IN(SELECT sogg_ID FROM tableA where ID_A=targetId)
tbl sogg_ID NomeN CognN

Or direct pass ID

SELECT 'B' as tbl, ID_B as sogg_ID,Nome_B    as NomeN,Cogn_B as CognN FROM tableB
WHERE ID_B IN(SELECT sogg_ID FROM tableA where ID_A=55)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'C' as tbl, ID_C as sogg_ID, Nome_C   as NomeN, Cogn_C as CognN  FROM tableC
WHERE ID_C IN(SELECT sogg_ID FROM tableA where ID_A=55)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'D' as tbl, ID_D as sogg_ID, Nome_D as NomeN, Cogn_D as CognN  FROM tableD
WHERE ID_D IN(SELECT sogg_ID FROM tableA where ID_A=55)

Q: Electron application can't resolve 'greenworks-linux32' on Steamworks integration A:

I build own nodejs library for Steamworks SDK integration called steamworks-ffi-node. The only thing you need is to put steamworks redistribution files inside of your project Doc and just add support for achievements in your code.
